hits.adjudication: CLEARED: CORRECT AS WRITTEN, and it is this batch that was wrong. Institute Time Clauses - Hulls (1/11/95) cl. 4.2 terminates hull cover AUTOMATICALLY on suspension, discontinuance or withdrawal of class. Rounds 1-3 of this batch replaced that with 'cover may be prejudiced', which was an over-correction; round 4 reversed it across every card it had touched. This note was right all along.
